extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students and scholars of American history and constitutional law
extracted.subtask_description: A collected edition of the 85 essays (The Federalist Papers) by Hamilton, Madison, and Jay arguing for ratification of the U.S. Constitution; intended as primary-source political/persuasive essays from 1787–1788. The page is the Project Gutenberg plain-text eBook of the complete collection.
